values.result: Coherent wildlife photo packs with crops and resized exports, metadata, and an optional map end card, preserved from every original and placed somewhere I can review on my phone before sharing. Outputs should trace to originals and show exceptions.
values.quality: Packs are coherent; crops and resized exports are present; metadata is included; an optional map end card is included when appropriate; originals are preserved; each output traces to its original; exceptions are visible; and the result is practical to review on a phone. Exact image-quality, crop-failure, location, and carousel-dimension thresholds are still to be approved.
values.failures: Never delete or overwrite originals. Do not accept a poor crop or a duplicate subject, and do not expose an exact location. Do not invent missing location data, hide exceptions, or claim that the workflow ran when it has not.
values.effort: I review the completed packs before sharing. Timing targets, image-quality thresholds, crop-failure limits, missing-location handling, carousel dimensions, delivery service, weekly volume, and phone-storage limits are unknown and need clarification or approval rather than assumed guarantees.
